title: Great way to get yo know the city.
text: Valentina was lovely. Had a private tour. She was very willing to show us anything we wanted. She really knew the city and had great suggestions and information for us. My daughter enjoyed her too
author: ganuzzo

title: A Great Start
text: The tour was exactly as advertised. Our tour guide Shari most definitely loves the city of Barcelona and shared this appreciation with us. It was a personal tour. I highly recommend this as a nice start to your visit in Barcelona.
author: Deirdre_L

title: Kickstart is a Must
text: What a friendly, funny, nice & knowledgeable guy August is. We really enjoyed the Kickstart of Barcelona. Never rushed us & showed us everything & more.
author: Marlene_A

title: Barcelona, Day 1!!!
text: Don't have a lot of time, then this is a must tour.  Or if you arrive early evening, this tour gets you acclimated to the Barcelona.  Our tour guide Shari was great.  She was accommodating given that we were a little late, but Shari met with us and was understanding.  She walked us around the Gothic area, visiting various churches, the burning flame of Catalan, to the the Bandstand dedicated to Sonia where live salsa dancing was happening at The Parc de la Ciutadella that also had a massive monumental waterfall, a pond and a romantic English garden dated back to 1888. author: Cluny_L

title: great tour experience with Augusto
text: We had a great tour experience with Augusto!  He was right on time, and very knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona, especially the Gothic quarter and El Born area.  He shared great stories and bits of trivia at each stop on the way.  He also catered the tour to specific areas of interest for us.  We'd definitely recommend him for another tour.
author: rtodd1908

title: Fantastic tour!
text: We had a blast with Andy! Great knowledge of the city and personality to boot!  He gave us some great recommendations and showed us things we would have never found on our own!
author: Deborah_M

title: Kick off your visit with a review of Barcelona’s history through important sights.
text: Had a fabulous walk about the city with a quick synopsis of Barcelona’s history.  Our guide answered questions and gave tips for the rest of our stay.
author: Michelle W

title: Nice start to your city trip
text: We had a nice start to our city trip in Barcelona with this walk. Laura, our guide knew a lot about the city and its history.
author: Kim O

title: Fabulous 2 hour tour in Barcelona.
text:
We met our guide Elizabeth spot on 11.00am .we were a small group of 3 .
The tour was excellent Elizabeth was brilliant and we covered a great areas of interest in the amount of time we had .
I would highly recommend this tour
author: hullite60

title: Great for first day in Barcelona
text: Our tour guide, Laura, was very knowledgeable and fun.  It was a great into to the Gothic area and Las Ramblas.
